verdict.rationale: Temporal's core is open-source and self-hostable via Docker, Kubernetes or manual deployment, which offers an exit path from Temporal Cloud. The Client and CLI can list and query Workflow Executions, and Cloud metrics stream in the open OpenMetrics format. However, nothing documents a dedicated export of all account or workflow data in open formats, or a Cloud-to-self-hosted migration path. missing for 10: documented full data export (workflow histories, schedules, namespace config) in open formats, documented Cloud exit/migration process, independent corroboration of leaving with data intact.
